freeze.blocked.cli: 🛑 the project is FROZEN — `%s` will not run.
freeze.blocked.work_safe: The work you have done stays on your local branch.
freeze.blocked.what_still_works: To investigate: `anchors status`, `anchors doctor` and `anchors guide` still work
freeze.no_reason: (no reason declared — whoever froze it did not write `freeze_reason` in anchors.yaml)
freeze.already.retry: to change the reason, run `anchors thaw` and freeze again.
freeze.reason_required: --reason is required: write what happened, because it is the text EVERY refused command will show
freeze.done.bypass: Whoever FIXES it gets through: `--no-verify` on the hooks, admin on the ruleset.
thaw.not_frozen: ○ the project is not frozen — nothing to do.
thaw.cache_warning:
Anyone with a warm hook cache may take up to 10 minutes to notice —
  or run `git fetch` to force it.
check.blocked_by_judgment:
✗ blocked — %d target(s) awaiting judgment.
  The judgment belongs to THIS commit: whoever touched the file is the one
  holding the context to answer. Resolve before committing:
      anchors judge --pending
check.pending_note: Pending is not a defect: it is the gate saying something was declared and not yet decided. It does not block, and it does not go away on its own.
check.legend.skip: indeterminate — the gate had nothing to confront
map.version_mismatch:
⚠ the map was written by `anchors %s` and this is %s.
  Different versions write the map differently: the older one UNDOES what the newer wrote, and the map starts oscillating — a conflict on every PR, with nobody at fault.
  Update the binary (or run `anchors map build` with the new one and commit) before going on.
not_governed: %q is not governed by the Structure (matches no layer in `layers:`) — nothing to confront
check.no_deterministic_gate: no deterministic gate to run (all of them are judgment gates).
check.no_gate_for_slice: no gate to run for this slice (phase=%q category=%q).
check.awaiting_ai_judgment: %d target(s) awaiting AI judgment — run `anchors next` (or `anchors judge --pending`)
check.output_mirrored: output mirrored to %s — read it from there instead of running again.
status.git_missing:
⚠ git not installed — the change stamp, `coverage --diff` and the
  hooks are off. Install git.
status.no_git_repo:
⚠ no git repository.
  → NEXT STEP: `git init` (or run `anchors init`, which offers to do it)
status.not_started:
○ project not started yet: no PROJECT.md and no anchors.yaml.

  → NEXT STEP: the DISCOVER phase — a 5-step interview that decides
    stack, architecture, structure and conventions, and writes PROJECT.md.
    An AI runs it: use `anchors guide project` for the rule,
    or `anchors init`, which recognizes the state and instructs.
